guard: An inline persona in a workflow spawn reaches the manager whole as its persona record, is bound into the step with its digest before anything is submitted and restated by the acceptance bind, a resume never submits a definition other than the one it recorded, and a migration hands an adopted seat only to a spawn of the same definition.
why: The suite imports the runtime's source, so no rebuild is needed around a mutant.

M1 drops the bind before submission, M2 drops the restatement in the acceptance bind, M3 drops the recorded-digest check on resume, M4 drops the adoption digest check, M5 drops the persona record from the spawn args, and M6 makes the bind once the manager has answered the submission and before the acceptance bind, so the journal's order still passes and only the journal as the manager received the request can catch it.

mutations.name: M1 the definition is not bound before submission
mutations.find: if (inline !== undefined && recordedInline === undefined) await ctx.bind({ inline });
mutations.expectRed: the definition and its digest are bound before the submission, with no goal yet
mutations.cell: the definition and its digest are bound before the submission, with no goal yet

mutations.expectRed: and the acceptance bind restates them beside the goal
mutations.cell: and the acceptance bind restates them beside the goal
